description: Find businesses and landmarks near a place in Mappit's directory of 14.9 million OpenStreetMap entries: by name ("Pike Place Market"), by kind ("pharmacy", "hotel", "cafe") or by cuisine ("ramen"). Nearest first, with address, opening hours, website and phone where OpenStreetMap has them. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

category.description: One of: food-drink, shopping, health, services, culture, recreation, education, lodging, office.

near.description: Where to look: a place name, a landmark ("Pike Place Market"), a place id or "lat,lon".

q.description: A name, a kind of place or a cuisine ("Starbucks", "pharmacy", "ramen"). Omit to list what is nearest.

radius_km.description: How far to look in km: default 5, at most 50.

name: find_places
title: Find businesses and places
